content_sections.body:
Vy: Hi! My name is Vy. What's your name?
Noah: I'm Noah.
Vy: How do you spell that?
Noah: N-O-A-H.
Vy: Where are you from?
Noah: I'm from Canada. Nice to meet you.
Vy: Nice to meet you, too.
content_sections.title: A complete introduction

content_sections.body: Begin with a greeting. Ask one question at a time and listen to the answer. Use a short polite response before the next question. End the exchange clearly.
content_sections.title: Build the conversation

exercises.prompt: Have a six-turn first-meeting conversation using a fictional identity if preferred.
exercises.rubric: Begins and ends appropriately.; Asks at least two target questions accurately.; Gives clear, relevant answers.; Uses one polite listening response.

objectives: Combine greetings, names, spelling, age, and place in a short conversation.
Use polite listening responses such as Thank you and Nice to meet you.

constraints: Use only language reviewed in Unit 1.
Do not use external text or media.
listening.goal: Practise the listening target for this lesson.
listening.instruction: Read an original first-meeting conversation of four short lines. Keep it hidden and ask, one at a time, for the person's name, spelling, and country. Reveal the script after the third answer.

constraints: If audio is unavailable, state NOT_ASSESSED and describe stress only.
Do not assess from transcription alone.
pronunciation.goal: Practise the pronunciation target for this lesson.
pronunciation.instruction: Model the question rhythm in What's your name?, How do you spell that?, and Where are you from? Ask the learner to repeat each question and then use one in a mini-dialogue.

constraints: Keep the exchange to six tutor turns or fewer.
speaking.goal: Practise the speaking target for this lesson.
speaking.instruction: Role-play a new classmate and conduct a short exchange about name, spelling, and place. Ask one question per turn and let the learner ask you at least one question.

constraints: Do not supply a full replacement dialogue.
Keep all suggested language within Unit 1 scope.
writing.goal: Practise the writing target for this lesson.
writing.instruction: Ask the learner to draft a six-line first-meeting dialogue. Check greeting, question forms, be, and closing; give at most three brief comments and request a revision.

title: Meet a New Classmate
